notes: Stage 2 = Years 3-4. Stage 3 = Years 5-6. Stage 4 = Years 7-8. MAO-WM-01 (Working mathematically) is the cross-stage Mathematics process outcome and applies alongside the relevant content outcome for any maths question. Only Stage 4 Core outcomes are listed for Mathematics (Path/Adv outcomes belong to Stage 5/Y9-10 and are out of scope for Y3-7).
